name: Tatas Handharu
title: Tatas Handharu — AI Systems Engineer
description: Portfolio of Tatas Handharu Sworo, Tech Lead AI Systems based in Jakarta, building AI platforms for cyber threat intelligence, social media monitoring and blockchain analytics.

about.label: (About)
about.statement: I build AI systems that turn messy, fast-moving data into intelligence people can act on. My work sits where machine learning, cybersecurity and backend engineering meet — platforms that read the web, flag what matters and keep running in production.
about.practice: My practice spans LLM and RAG applications, AI agents, data pipelines and FastAPI backends. I take models from research to containerised production, with monitoring and observability built in.
about.offDuty: Before industry I was an assistant lecturer at University of Technology Yogyakarta, running Big Data and Machine Learning sessions. In my spare time I explore Web3 and blockchain tooling.
